svg.title: A message is typed a little each frame
svg.desc: At the top, the game itself: her window opens, the line is typed into it, and the arrow bobs while the window waits. Below, frame by frame: Garet's sister's line in Vale, "You guys are so lucky, Garet.", typed into its window at the normal message speed. Each frame the window gets one more letter cell: a single letter, or two narrow letters that fit together in one cell 16 pixels wide. On the first frame "Yo" appears, on the second "You", on the fourth "You gu", and on the 18th the whole first page; a space and the line break take a frame each. Then an arrow shows and the window waits for a button before the next page. The player's message speed decides how fast the cells come: at the slow speed one cell and then a pause of 4 frames, which is skipped while a button is held; at the normal speed one cell a frame; at the fast speed up to ten a frame, but a space ends the frame's share, so about a word a frame.
svg.text: IN THE GAME, AT THE NORMAL SPEED

g.text: FRAME BY FRAME: ONE CELL A FRAME
Then an arrow: a button turns the page.
A cell is 16 pixels wide: one letter, or
two narrow ones that fit in it together.
a cell, then a pause of 4 frames
no pause while a button is held
a space ends the frame's share: about a word
